# Intology Locus submission

These files were provided by Intology for the Locus PostTrainBench v1.1 result.
The PostTrainBench team manually reviewed the submitted runs for compliance.

- `locus_run_1.csv`, `locus_run_2.csv`, and `locus_run_3.csv` contain the three individual score seeds.
- `aggregated_avg_locus.csv` and `aggregated_std_locus.csv` contain per-cell sample means and standard deviations.
- `single_metrics_aggregated.csv` contains the weighted overall score.
- `time_aggregated.csv` records the submitted mean runtime across all 84 runs. No runtime standard deviation was provided.

The PostTrainBench efficiency plots show the submitted mean runtime without an error bar.
